children: sank 15.7% in Monday's trading after saying it  plans to launch a non-brokered
issuing units at a price of C$0.28/unit to raise gross proceeds of as much as C$5M.

Each unit is comprised of one share of common stock of the company and one-half of one common stock purchase warrant, with each offered warrant entitling the holder to acquire one share of common stock at a price of C$0.45 per warrant share up to 24 months following the closing date.

said it plans to use the proceeds of the offering to fund its exploration programs, including the drilling program at its Sarita Este/Desierto project in Argentina, and other forecast expenditures through year-end 2027, including the recent option payment for Desierto.

Since the offering would result in the issuance of securities exceeding 25% of the number of currently issued and outstanding shares of the company permitted by the Toronto Stock Exchange without shareholder approval, Golden Minerals
said it has applied for a "financial hardship" exemption from applicable shareholder approval requirements.

said it is experiencing "serious financial difficulty," as available funds will be exhausted by year-end 2026 without additional financing, and the company has no revenue-producing operations and has ongoing funding requirements associated with its mineral projects.

title: Golden Minerals says suffering from 'serious financial difficulty,' launches C$5M private placement
